LAW AND MOTION 301, PETITION FOR CONFIRMATION OF ARBITRATION AWARD,AND APPOINTMENT OF NEUTRAL ARBITRATOR. APPEARANCES: JAMES PAUL GREEN, ESQ., APPEARED ON BEHALF OF PETITIONER AND MOVING PARTIES BUZZ BENSE ET AL. JEFF ROSEN, ESQ., APPEARED ON BEHALF OF RESPONDENT AND OPPOSING PARTY JAY TOBIN. AFTER ARGUMENT THE COURT GRANTED PLAINTIFFS' PETITION TO CONFIRM ARBITRATION AWARD. THE PLAINTIFFS' REQUEST FOR ATTORNEY FEES WAS DENIED. THE REQUEST FOR APPOINTMENT OF ARBITRATOR WAS DENIED WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO BRING A PETITION TO COMPEL ARBITRATION. JUDGE:JAMES J. MCBRIDE REPORTER: ERIC THRONE, CSR # 7855
ORDER CONFIRMING ARBITRATION AWARD AS JUDGT
